plays.desc_ko: 게임 시작 직후 LYON이 레드 버프 와드와 강가 와드를 촘촘히 깔고, Isles가 스위퍼를 들고 바텀 부쉬로 먼저 달려가 시야를 장악함. 레벨1 알리스타의 견제는 없었다고 해설됨.
plays.desc_en: Right after the game starts, LYON densely wards red buff and the river, and Isles rushes to the bot brush with a Sweeper to take vision control. Casters note there was no level 1 harass from Alistar.
plays.quote: intense opening game warding from ... Lion. They got the red buff ward as well ... start with Isles with the sweeper on

plays.desc_ko: Inspired가 바텀 방향으로 첫 정글링을 마무리하고 스커틀을 노린 뒤 곧바로 귀환함. 해설은 교전은 없을 것 같다고 언급.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 라인으로 복귀하며 칼날부리(랩터) 쪽에 와드를 추가로 박아 Canyon의 다음 정글 동선을 보려 함.
plays.desc_en: Saint drops an extra ward near the raptors on his way back to lane to track Canyon's next jungle path.
plays.quote: Saint goes back up to get another ward ... towards Raptors.

plays.desc_ko: 바텀 라인에서 Duro(알리스타)가 박치기를 반복적으로 사용해 칼리스타·레나타와의 교환을 짧게 끊고 밀쳐냄.

plays.quote: a classic Alister move from Doru, ... just consistently using the headbutt to ... disengage or force back.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 사이드 부쉬로 돌아 들어가 귀환함. 해설은 시간 손실은 크지 않아 보인다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Saint slips into a side brush to recall. Casters say the time loss looks minor.
plays.quote: all the way around over to the side ... brush here to go for his recall.

plays.desc_ko: Canyon이 두 번째 풀캠프 정글링 후 리셋하여 브루탈라이저와 제어 와드를 구매, 강가 시야 장악을 준비함.
plays.desc_en: Canyon resets after his second full clear, buying Serrated Dirk and a Control Ward to prepare for river vision control.
plays.quote: Another full clear for both junglers ... get his brutalizer ... off this reset as well as the control

plays.desc_ko: 같은 시점 Inspired도 두 번째 풀캠프 정글링 후 리셋함.
plays.desc_en: At the same time, Inspired also resets after his second full clear.
plays.quote: Another full clear for both junglers ... into the reset.

plays.desc_en: With bot and mid waves pushed and Canyon's position confirmed, Inspired moves the Scuttle down to create a 3v3 setup and LYON secures the first dragon. Whether GEN contested is unclear, per the casters.
plays.quote: going for a bit of a slow ... push there on the bottom lane trying to ... stack these waves

plays.desc_ko: 해설이 회고적으로, LYON 바텀 듀오가 일찍 미드 쪽으로 스왑해 공허 유충을 확보했고 결과적으로 두 중립 오브젝트(유충·드래곤)를 모두 챙겼다고 설명함.
plays.desc_en: Looking back, casters explain LYON's bot duo swapped toward mid early to take the Voidgrubs, ending up with both neutral objectives.
plays.quote: fine. So, that's why we see the bot lane ... swap towards mid really early on ... for it, but you secure your grubs

plays.desc_en: Kiin lingers top during the lane swap as a trap, and Duro joins to combo down Dhokla (Olaf), who had already used his ultimate, giving GEN First Blood. Kiin then resets and clears bot with The Equalizer.
plays.quote: A TRAP AND THE TRAP AND ... THEY INSTANTLY GET FIRST BLOOD. ... before, but Keen, he just overstays.

plays.desc_ko: 같은 시점 Chovy가 반대편(바텀)으로 내려가 웨이브를 받아 Kiin의 탑 잔류를 가능하게 했고, 텔레포트까지 써서 웨이브를 챙김.
plays.desc_en: Meanwhile Chovy heads bot to catch the wave, enabling Kiin to stay top, even using Teleport to collect it.
plays.quote: Chovy is the one that they sent down to ... actually walked down there, took care of ... Yeah, so smart. And Chovy invests his

plays.desc_en: Ruler looks for aggressive trades in bot lane; casters view it as roughly even.
plays.quote: is some aggressive trading from Rulers ... traded back here, and nothing happening

plays.quote: Maybe he's forced to all here. Does dash ... out. Still gets clipped by Canyon. ... Uh that was just completely taken away.

plays.desc_en: LYON forces an Infernal Drake attempt but is pushed back by Chovy's ultimate and wall while Isles gets stunned; Inspired chips Canyon to pull Qiyana off, but Canyon steals the dragon.
plays.quote: Lion desperate to get this drake. ... forced back. A wall to disengage ... And Inspire says, "Okay, I'm going to go

plays.desc_en: While Chovy's ultimate and wall push LYON away, Canyon dashes in and Smites the dragon at 76 HP to steal it.
plays.quote: Infernal drake GETTING PICKED UP BY ... OOH, CANYON DOES STEAL THE DRAGON. ... There was 76 HP left on the dragon.

plays.desc_en: LYON chases right after the steal: Saint's Flash Charm lands on Chovy, and after the egg breaks Isles pulls him with Handshake Deal and Berserker's Rend stacks finish Chovy. Inspired chases down Ruler, and casters say LYON was rewarded with kills.

plays.quote: GenG making a very similar play along ... Dokla has to hang out under his tier

plays.desc_ko: GEN은 전령 주변 탑 시야를 미리 깔아 두었고, Chovy가 바텀 웨이브를 받은 뒤 강가로 올라오다가 다시 내려가며 전령 견제를 포기함.
plays.desc_en: GEN had pre-warded top around the Herald, but Chovy catches the bot wave, moves up the river, then drops back down, abandoning the contest.
plays.quote: The Harold is on the table and all of ... the vision control for GenG on the top ... Okay, Chovy actually

plays.quote: Lion doing what they can ... now to clear out that vision ... after all. So, Lion claimed the Harold.

plays.desc_ko: LYON이 Duro에게 큰 피해를 넣어 궁극기를 빼려 했으나 피해가 부족했고 GEN은 뒤로 빠짐.
plays.desc_en: LYON pokes Duro hard to bait out his ultimate, but the damage falls short and GEN backs off.
plays.quote: bit of a chunk onto Doro. The hope there ... is just to get that ulti out from him. ... They're not quite enough damage to be

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤 앞에서 GEN의 초반 콤보가 Isles에게 들어가 회복(힐)과 점멸을 강제로 소모시킴.

plays.quote: AND THE DRAGON here leads over to the ... Berserker to get a bunch of spears in ... dragon number three here for Lion.

plays.desc_en: After resetting, LYON leaves Saint (Ahri) splitting top while the rest push mid and re-establish vision around Baron.
plays.quote: Meanwhile, Lion on their reset, too. ... They keep the Ahri split pushing up on ... configuration here. Retake the vision

plays.desc_en: With an HP lead, GEN re-engages as Duro forces out Saint's Flash and pushes LYON off, trading Saint's and Isles' Flashes for Ruler's and Canyon's.

plays.quote: Cuz GenG are actually there ... all the vision first. ... they're very willing to sacrifice some

plays.quote: Doku splitting. ... buying time for Dokes. ... Doku is

plays.desc_en: Having conceded Baron, GEN uses Teleports and more to trade for the dragon, denying LYON the soul.
plays.quote: Genji should ... be able to trade dragon and deny the ... They've lost

plays.quote: what they can with the pressure they've ... Baron buff. Tier two starting to fall.

plays.quote: another fight breaking out. Isles picked ... Berserker not close enough to save him. ... That's Isles down

Saint flanks, missing Charm on Ruler but landing Orb of Deception, Isles' ultimate hits one target, and Dhokla Flashes in to Exhaust Ruler. A missed final axe lets Ruler escape, but the team kills Chovy and his egg; casters call it a 1-for-2 in LYON's favor.

plays.quote: THEY'RE GOING ... TO PUSH WITH THOSE KILLS. ... hoping to break open the inhibitor line.

plays.desc_ko: 영혼 드래곤을 앞두고 LYON이 먼저 자리를 잡음(GEN은 깊은 와드를 다수 배치). 양측 다수의 점멸이 빠진 상태라는 해설.
plays.desc_en: Ahead of soul dragon, LYON takes position first while GEN places many deep wards. Casters note many Flashes are down on both sides.
plays.quote: time Lion are hosting. They've got the ... early position. ... A lot of deep wards for Gen.G.

plays.desc_ko: Saint가 먼저 대시로 들어가 콤보 후 빠지고 Ruler가 궁극기를 소진, Dhokla는 작은 부쉬에서 측면 대기. Inspired가 점멸로 진입해 띄우기, 초승달 방패로 막고, Berserker는 무사하며 Dhokla 궁 이후 GEN이 무너짐. Inspired가 중앙으로 뛰어들어 Chovy를 처치, Kiin은 Renata 악수를 피해 도주. LYON이 한타 승리.
plays.desc_en: Saint dashes in, combos, and exits as Ruler burns his ultimate, while Dhokla waits in a small brush to flank. Inspired Flashes in for a knock-up and blocks with Crescent Guard, Berserker stays safe, and GEN collapses after Dhokla's ultimate. Inspired dives in to kill Chovy while Kiin dodges Handshake Deal to flee, and LYON wins the fight.
plays.quote: Saint once again dashing forward. Combo ... Now we've got big Dovks on the flank ... Inspired going in

plays.desc_ko: 한타 승리 후 LYON이 미드·바텀을 동시에 밀어 포탑과 넥서스까지 진격, 1세트 승리.
plays.desc_en: After the teamfight, LYON pushes mid and bot simultaneously through the turrets to the Nexus, winning Game 1.
plays.quote: MID LANE GETTING ... PUSHED. BOT LANE GETTING PUSHED. ... LION PUSHING.
